question: A circular disc of radius 7 cm is inscribed inside an equilateral triangle. What is the approximate area of the remaining portion of the triangle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an equilateral triangle circumscribing a circle of radius r, the remaining area can be directly calculated as:

⇒ Remaining Area = r² × (3√3 − π)

⇒ Remaining Area = 7² × (3 × 1.732 − 3.142)

⇒ Remaining Area ≈ 49 × (5.196 − 3.142) = 49 × 2.054

⇒ Remaining Area ≈ 100.64 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 100.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the inscribed circular disc (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Inradius of equilateral triangle = a ÷ 2√3 (where a is the side length)

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

Area of a circle = π × r²

 

 
 
 
• 
 r = 7 cm
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 a = 14√3 cm
 Remaining Area = Area of Triangle − Area of Circle

**Calculations:**

⇒ a ÷ 2√3 = 7

⇒ a = 14√3 cm

⇒ Area of the equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × (14√3)²

⇒ Area of the equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × 196 × 3 = 147√3 cm²

⇒ Taking √3 ≈ 1.732

⇒ Area of the triangle ≈ 147 × 1.732 = 254.604 cm²

⇒ Area of the circle = (22 ÷ 7) × 7² = 154 cm²

⇒ Remaining Area = Area of the triangle − Area of the circle

⇒ Remaining Area = 254.604 − 154 = 100.604 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 100.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Circumcircle of an Equilateral Triangle

The circumradius (R) of an equilateral triangle is exactly double its inradius. Formula: R = a ÷ √3 = 2r.

Area Ratio of Incircle and Circumcircle

For any equilateral triangle, the ratio of the area of the incircle to the area of the circumcircle is always 1:4.

Height of an Equilateral Triangle

The height or median (h) divides the triangle symmetrically. Formula: h = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.
